QuestInfo.name: [Carcion] War Stories
QuestInfo.0: Some of the Turtle Anima suffered the same curse as the native creatures of Carcion. Learn more from #b#p3006516##k, the chief of the Turtle Anima.
QuestInfo.1: Some of the Turtle Anima suffered the same curse as the native creatures of Carcion. Learn more from #b#p3006516##k, the chief of the Turtle Anima.
QuestInfo.2: Using the #bWorld Heart#k, you absorbed the godly power that had infected the Turtle Anima. In return, they agreed to assist the Alliance. Duhan informed you that the Snake Anima were collaborating with the High Flora. Moments later, news arrived that the Turtle scouts had been attacked.
